purpose: Teach: をめぐって/促す/西欧/源泉/日本海/団結/結びつい/乏しい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 欧州市場をめぐって、再編が進んでいる。
lines.en: The European market is undergoing significant restructuring.
lines.style: Measured opening. Calm, authoritative tone. Even pacing, each phrase weighted with authority. Clear pronunciation on key terms. No affect—just fact delivered with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。西欧拠点、製造リードと結びついた強みです。
lines.en: Yes. Our Western European hubs give us a real advantage tied to manufacturing lead time.
lines.style: Steady, slightly deferential. Speaks with measured precision—not robotic, but careful. Slight emphasis on the connection between location and capability. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 供給の源泉が乏しい部材、対策を促すよう指示しろ。
lines.en: For materials with limited sources, I want you to push the teams to develop countermeasures.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. Sharp attack on the opening. Clipped pacing. Each clause feels like an instruction, not a suggestion. Authority without volume. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 日本海側の港湾、リスク分散に検討中です。
lines.en: The Sea of Japan ports are currently under review as part of our risk-diversification strategy.
lines.style: Composed update. Steady pace, careful articulation. The tone of someone delivering progress on an assignment. Slight rise at the end—inviting acknowledgment, not apology.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Don't lose sight of team cohesion through all of this.
lines.style: Final weight. Slower pace on this sentence. Warm but firm—not a rebuke, a reminder. The voice of someone who has seen reorganisations fracture teams before. Quiet conviction.
